fightSong.title: Layer by Layer
fightSong.lyrics: Deep in the heart of the Windy City / We build it thick, we build it gritty / Layer by layer, we never fold / Deep-Dish football, Chicago gold!

stadium.name: The Deep Freeze
stadium.tradition: The First Slice — before kickoff, a local pizzeria owner cuts a 6-foot deep-dish with a hockey stick. If the cheese pull stretches over 3 feet, it's good luck. Current record: 7'2".

fanCulture.description: Fans arrive 5 hours early to 'let it bake.' They wear oven mitts instead of gloves in December. After every sack, the PA plays a 4-second oven timer *ding*. Booing is replaced with 'NEEDS MORE SAUCE.'
fanCulture.tailgate: Actual deep-dish ovens in the parking lot. Judged on crust integrity at kickoff.

rivalries.name: The Motor City Bake-Off
rivalries.narrative: Detroit style vs Chicago style. It's been a fistfight since 1961. Detroit fans bring square pans, Chicago fans bring depth.

rivalries.name: The Frozen Tundra Deep-Dish
rivalries.narrative: Minnesota brings hotdish to a pizza fight. We bring layers. It's cold, it's petty, it's perfect.

paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: TOUCHDOWN CHICAGO! That's a deep-dish six!

cityFlavor: Second City syndrome, first-class pizza. We measure snow in feet and loyalty in generations. If it's not built to survive January, we don't want it.
